notes: Consolidated IFRS accounts in fullCHF units; netIncome and totalEquity are attributable to shareholders of the parent, not total profit/equity including noncontrolling interests.

The five-year reviews in the2010,2015,2020 and2025 financial statements supply the historic sales, attributable net profit, assets, operating cash flow, dividend and employee series. Actual income statements supply operatingIncome and dilutedEPS: trading operating profit and underlying trading operating profit are not substituted. Before2011 the published line is Profit before interest and taxes.

capex is the cash-flow-statement Capital expenditure line (PP&E), stored negative; intangible-asset expenditure is separately reported and is not added. Capital additions in recent five-year reviews include noncash and business-combination/right-of-use additions and are not used.
cashAndEquivalents is the balance-sheet amount. It excludes cash in assets held for sale, which causes a difference from some cash-flow-statement closing balances (notably2009,2024 and2025).

The latest inspected2018report restates2017 for IFRS15 and related accounting changes;2013report/2015review restate2012 for IFRS11 and IAS19;2011OCF uses the2015review restated figure.2007 per-share data reflect the2008share split and balance sheet restatement as published. IFRS16 applies from2019 without historical restatement of all earlier years.

Historical revenue and operating profit reflect the reporting scope in the latest inspected published historical summaries; Alcon disposal in2010 generated a large attributable net gain and preinterest/tax profit, and earlier years include the Alcon business. No artificial like-for-like history is calculated.
dividendPerShare is the fiscal-year dividend, paid or proposed for payment in the following year;2025 is the board proposal printed in the2025report.

employees is the rounded figure published in thousands scaled to persons.2021/2022 are FTE while2023-2025 are headcount, as the2025review explicitly notes; historical definitions otherwise follow the source review.

totalDebt is null because no verified single aggregate matching the required debt scope was extracted; net financial debt is not substituted and current/noncurrent balances are not summed. sharesOutstanding is null because the summaries publish weighted-average EPS shares rather than period-end outstanding shares, and issued less treasury shares is not computed.
